scope: Selected algorithms, public ABI, physical VDI, fault/ownership and exact packaged scrolling acceptance; not release qualification or a MagiC speed comparison

upstream.license: GPL-2.0-or-later; retain GEM4XE COPYING and source provenance

selection.src/vdi/vdi.c: vdi_vro_cpyfm normalization and paired clipping model; widened in geometry.h
selection.src/vdi/dev_vbxe.c: copy_rows logical row merge and rop_code recipes

cc65816.version: Calypsi ISO C compiler for 65816 version 5.18

excluded_runtime: src/sys startup, context switching, IRQ/COP handlers and memory probing
CIO font loading, virtual workstations, AES and GEMDOS

access_timing.scope: Instrumented solid-fill and callback fixture, including assertion and marker costs. Conservative CPU charge excludes native interrupts and off-Task time. An ordinary callback injects Yield with renderer staging live; ownership must survive Task switching without overlapping renderer access. access_wait includes arbitration and bridge costs.

cpu_trace.scope: Conservative caller CPU charge including kernel and bus stalls; native IRQ/NMI and peer Task time separate

reserved_bank_zero_delta.includes: guards, alignment and unused reserved capacity

cc65816.version: Calypsi ISO C compiler for 65816 version 5.18

pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

limits: Development tier only; complete hosted release qualification remains open
Four timing samples with operation-specific rectangles; no latency percentile or cross-machine speed claim
Checked scanout is a frame-resolution observation upper bound, not a hardware completion timestamp
Smallest stress-fixture stack spare above the 256-byte interrupt reserve is 20 bytes
S_ONLY auxiliary source-edge capture preserves its existing whole-source boundary (at most 480 bytes)
Distinct MFDB aliases with different base/pitch descriptions are caller responsibility
Standard planar forms, scaling, other depths, vrt_cpyfm, vr_trnfm and bitmap workstations remain unsupported
